audience: creators and product teams that make voices and speech with their ElevenLabs account

useCases.title: Check plan usage before a large job
useCases.text: Read the plan tier, the character usage and limit, and when the character count resets. Confirm which account the key belongs to.

useCases.title: Review the voices in your library
useCases.text: List the voices of your account. Read the labels, sharing state and default settings of one voice.

useCases.title: Find a voice in the shared library
useCases.text: Search public voices by name, gender, accent, language or use case. List the speech models to get a model id.

useCases.title: Review past speech generations
useCases.text: List recent speech history by voice, model, text or date. Open one item to read its text, settings and state.

useCases.title: Delete a speech history item
useCases.text: Delete one speech history item. Its generated audio is removed too, and the audio cannot be recovered.
